672ba7b3dacbfa91c0c049891d435b2e.reasoning: The log records four business routines interleaved in a single browser session. Nodes 0 and 1 are the initial authentication actions that setup the portal session, which is shared among all four routines. Node 2 and Node 3 open and navigate to the Webmail inbox; this action is shared by Travel Authorization, Expense Reimbursement, and Purchase Order Approval as they all rely on email links/attachments, whereas Student Grant Disbursement does not use the webmail. Nodes 4 and 5 open the U-GOV accounting module, which is exclusively used by the Expense Reimbursement routine for booking accounting entries. Node 6 opens the Purchase and Supplier Portal ('Portale Acquisti e Fornitori'), which is shared between Purchase Order Approval (processing purchase orders) and Student Grant Disbursement (registering recipients under 'anagrafica-percipienti'). Finally, Node 113 is the logout step, which terminates the global session and serves all four routines.

shared_actions.justification: Navigates to the shared authentication portal to begin the global session.
Logs in using Sapienza credentials to authenticate the global session.
Opens Webmail, which is used to access emails and attachments for travel, expenses, and purchase orders.
Navigates to the webmail inbox to access incoming business emails.
Opens the U-GOV accounting system, which is only used by the Expense Reimbursement routine for accounting entries.
Navigates to the contabile section, enabling bookkeepings for expense reimbursements.
Opens the Purchase and Supplier Portal, which is used for managing purchase orders and registering grant recipients.
Logs out and cleans up the portal session for all executed routines.
